item.tib: rdzogs chen gser gyi lag len dpyid nyi'i sbrang char
item.coloph: de ltar gser zhun 'chad thabs sos char 'di/ gzhan phan gzigs pa'i rnam 'byor gsungs sprin kyis/ bskur (bskul) ngor rgyud dang bla ma'i klu dbang la/ dgongs don zhus nas phab pa bdag gis byas/ 'di la 'gal 'khrul 'brug gi sgra 'byin na/ rnam 'byor ldam bu bzod bshad glog 'phreng drin chen gsum la 'khyug gyis tsam dge des 'ga' la phan srid na/ bstan dang byang chub myur (smyu) gu 'khrungs 'gyur cig tshul 'di ni yang dgon bla ma'i g.yung drung gtsug phud kyis bka' phab ltar/ dmu rig (rigs) zhwa dkar 'dzin pa'i zhabs pad spyi bor len pa'i dge sbyor tshul ?shes bya la sbyar ba dge sarba mang ga lam//
